title: Replication Codebase: Green Offerings and Net-Zero Plans: Markets, Capabilities and Finance in European SMEs
description:
Complete econometric replication codebase for the empirical study "Green Offerings and Net-Zero Plans: Markets, Capabilities and Finance in European SMEs" (Target Journal: Business Strategy and the Environment, Wiley; Manuscript ID: BSE-26-6866; Status: Revision prepared for resubmission).

Version 2.3.0 provides the end-to-end verified replication suite: (1) sample construction, exact Q5/Q6 survey routing auditing, and a 253-variable raw-to-cleaned codebook from Flash Eurobarometer 498 (ZA7806) and Eurostat Digital Intensity (isoc_e_dii); (2) joint full-information maximum likelihood (FIML) bivariate probit estimation (N = 11,128; k = 48 per equation; 26 country FE, 3 NACE macro-sector FE, 9 categorical turnover bracket FE, 9-item substantive resource-efficiency action count, 27-country clustered SEs, discrete sample-average marginal effects, cross-equation Wald tests, and 6-test Holm-Bonferroni and t_26 small-cluster p-values); (3) four-quadrant multinomial logit discrete marginal effects; (4) exact Newton-Raphson logistic propensity-score weighting (stabilized IPW with re-estimated propensity bootstrap and 27-country clustered influence-function SEs, distinguishing prespecified H3c moderation from exploratory subgroup checks) and doubly robust AIPW; (5) order-invariant optimal 1:1 bipartite logit-caliper propensity-score matching with exact binomial McNemar and normal-approximation Rosenbaum hidden-bias bounds across 13 matching/weighting specifications; (6) 12-specification consolidated robustness matrix, Q5/Q6 item non-response audit (N = 10,612 / 10,979 / 2,855), country-clustered probability-scale moderation, cross-level digital intensity OLS, 5-specification operating-cost ordered probits, construct-intensity validation, Q8 desired-support probits, and 2024 Wave 6 (ZA8869) out-of-sample replication; and (7) automated numerical, workbook, and figure verification suite (06_verify_all_results.py).

Data access: Microdata come from Flash Eurobarometer 498 (ZA7806, GESIS Data Archive, DOI: 10.4232/1.13934), Flash Eurobarometer 549 (ZA8869, GESIS Data Archive, DOI: 10.4232/1.14493, optional out-of-sample replication), and Eurostat Digital Intensity indicators (isoc_e_dii). In compliance with GESIS Terms of Use, raw Eurobarometer microdata files and firm-level microdata extracts are not redistributed in this archive; raw files can be downloaded from GESIS after free registration and placed in Data/ or Data/Raw/ as documented in README.md.
